recap: Install script downloads Vale v3.16.0 to ~/local/etc/vale + symlink; vale.ini activates write-good and proselint with vale sync
prose-lint script wraps Vale, accepts file arg or stdin, outputs flat JSON array with {line,rule,severity,match,message}, exits 0/1
slack-writer-end script copies draft text to clipboard via clipboard-write; supports argument and stdin input
Added Step 3 (Lint via prose-lint) and Step 4 (End via slack-writer-end) to slack-writer SKILL.md with checklist items
Disabled Google.Passive, Google.Timeless, write-good.ThereIs in all Vale profiles — suggestion-level rules caused noisy false positives in Slack and blog contexts
